# Volume 3 timeline

## Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) rest in the orchard at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), discussing the upcoming changes as [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepares to leave for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the bridge, but cuts their quiet moment short when he touches her hand. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts and talks with young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before sitting alone by the brook.

## Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Di](../character/di.md), [Eben Wright](../character/eben-wright.md), [Elisha Wright](../character/elisha-wright.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Peter Sloane](../character/peter-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they receive gifts before [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) to spite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). The next evening, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and takes her on a walk through the woods to find a wild apple tree, restoring her spirits ahead of her departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Chapter IV April’s Lady

**[Ada](../character/ada.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Hannah](../character/hannah.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) bids a tearful farewell to her home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and leaves for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). After a rainy drive to the station and a boat ride from [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) travel by train to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne.md) is warmly met by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her by cab to their new boardinghouse while cheering her up.

## Chapter V Letters from Home

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — After registering for classes at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feeling overwhelmed by the unfamiliar environment, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) take a stroll through Old St. John's Cemetery. There they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a friendly and talkative fellow student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). The three girls strike up an instant friendship while sitting on a gravestone, sharing their mutual feelings of homesickness and experiences on their first day.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats exuberantly with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors back home, her reluctance to grow up, and her impressions of [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After discovering an old war grave in the cemetery that deeply moves [Anne](../character/anne.md), the trio parts ways. [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) then discuss Phil's lively character, agreeing that despite her frivolity, they genuinely like her.

## Chapter VI In the Park

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), finding themselves drawn into social circles through their friendship with [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) earns distinction among the Freshmen after leading them to victory in the annual Arts Rush. Anne's homesickness is relieved when she receives a collection of letters from her friends and family back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Chapter VII Home Again

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Ada](../character/ada.md), [Davis](../character/davis.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) go for an afternoon walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) through the park and along the harbor shore. After watching the sunset from a pavilion, they walk back via [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) points out a charming, quaint house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a strong presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.

## Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), Carmody, [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [God](../character/god.md), Green Gables, [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md)** — After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.

## Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — During an overnight stay, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) declines the offer, and Jane accepts the refusal coolly while noting that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects with a mixture of amusement and disappointment at how unromantic her very first marriage proposal turned out to be.

## Chapter X Patty’s Place

**[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Tommy](../character/tommy.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while navigating romantic attentions from [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and unwanted proposals from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md). Later, she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) read a proposal from [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) to rent a house together for the next school year with Stella's [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) as housekeeper. After searching unsuccessfully all spring, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spot a 'To Let' sign on Patty's Place along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue).

## Chapter XI The Round of Life

**[Aaron](../character/aaron.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Afterward, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) to ask if she can live with them at Patty's Place, and they agree subject to consulting [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md).

## Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md)** — Upon returning to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices small changes in the community and learns from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill with consumption. On their way to visit [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) stop by to leave jelly with the sour and critical [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) confides in [Diana](../character/diana.md) her ambition to write a short story before they arrive at the lively Gillis home, where [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md) hides her failing health under a façade of gay flirtation.

## Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) works on writing her short story, discussing characters and plot details with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and later seeking feedback from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After completing the story, she submits it to two magazines, but receives rejections from both. Disheartened by the failures, [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to abandon her literary ambitions and put the manuscript away.

## Chapter XIV The Summons

**[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Tommy](../character/tommy.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md)** — Rebelling against Mrs. Lynde's instructions, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) so they can go fishing and play with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). Afterwards, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lies to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) to cover up his disobedience, but he is tormented by his guilty conscience. Late that night, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses everything to [Anne](../character/anne.md), who forgives him and encourages him to apologize to [God](../character/god.md).

## Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends an evening in the garden with [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her desire to go on living. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves, [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md) passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on life and death while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).

## Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Hamilton](../character/hamilton.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Hiram Sloane](../character/hiram-sloane.md), [Perceval](../character/perceval.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns that [Diana](../character/diana.md) secretly submitted her story to a baking powder contest after editing in commercial mentions, resulting in a prize win. Though dismayed by the commercialization of her story, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts Diana's good intentions. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later visits and helps reassure [Anne](../character/anne.md) by offering a practical perspective on the win.

## Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

**[Ada](../character/ada.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Patty](../character/patty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [William Blair](../character/william-blair.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place and decorate their new home. [Anne](../character/anne.md) reluctantly adopts a stray, disreputable cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who miraculously survives a chloroforming attempt and earns a permanent spot in the house. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives with her own cats, adding to the household's lively atmosphere.

**[Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) shares her relaxed views on chaperone duties and introduces her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat, to Patty's Place. [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) tries to fight both newcomers, getting put in his place by the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat and engaging in repeated battles with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) before becoming his close friend. The girls and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) chat comfortably together about their household routine and pet antics.

## Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Barry](../character/barry.md), Boulters, [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), Thanksgiving, White Sands Hotel, Wrights** — [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) chat about the snowy weather and rising prices. [Anne](../character/anne.md) then reads aloud a humorous letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), who reports on local news from home including Mrs. Lynde's misadventures, his school essay, and various neighborhood gossip.

## Chapter XIX An Interlude

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.

## Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [George](../character/george.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) discuss [Anne](../character/anne.md) turning twenty and her character growth. [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) joins them, showing off her dress before leaving for a dance while they chat about her suitors, including [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). After [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) departs, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) fondly ponder Phil's whimsical personality.

## Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — After chatting with [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) at Patty's Place, [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes out to the orchard where [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finds her and proposes. [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejects his proposal, insisting she only cares for him as a friend. A heartbroken [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to her room to weep, leaving her comforted and confronted by [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) over her decision.

## Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Alec](../character/alec.md), [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a pleasant two weeks visiting [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's homestead in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) while being courted by Phil's suitors. She visits her childhood home and meets the current owner, who gives her a packet of old love letters written by her deceased parents. After visiting her parents' graves in the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to read the letters, feeling deeply connected to her mother and father at last.

## Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sits by the fire thinking about her past and Anne's impact on her life when [Anne](../character/anne.md) arrives home a day early from college. The two share a warm reunion and talk about Gilbert's summer plans before [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) bursts in to excitedly greet [Anne](../character/anne.md) and chatter about his lost tooth, echoes, and future marriage plans.

## Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) enjoying visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and the Irvings, though she is secretly bothered by Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) deals with growing up and losing his imaginative childhood visions at the shore. Later at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) gently questions [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her disrupted relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

## Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Blake](../character/blake.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), [Lilly](../character/lilly.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — In a letter to [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) describes her summer at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), including the quirky guests at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse. She recounts meeting [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/blake.md), a theological student who initially seemed funny and ugly to her. After hearing him deliver a moving sermon, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) realizes her deep admiration for him and nervously contemplates whether she is falling in love.

## Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place before deciding to take a walk in the park. Catch in a sudden rainstorm, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets a handsome fellow [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) student named Royal Gardner, who rescues her with his umbrella and walks her home. Later that evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her housemates.

## Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Blake](../character/blake.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)** — While getting dressed for a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) compliments [Anne](../character/anne.md) on her dress and mentions that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels inexplicably bothered by the news and travels to the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). Upon arriving, [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room talking to the beautiful Christine and quietly compares her own appearance to hers.

## Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — At Patty's Place, the girls prepare for exams and learn that they can rent the house for another year while the owners travel abroad. Later, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) go for a walk in the park, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals she has accepted [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake's marriage proposal. As they discuss Phil's future and Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) ponders her ideal romance alongside Roy's lack of humor.

## Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md), [Carson](../character/carson.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.

## Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Blake](../character/blake.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Esther](../character/esther.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship as [Diana](../character/diana.md) nervously prepares to walk down the aisle. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) escorts [Anne](../character/anne.md) home and they take a moonlight walk through Lovers' Lane. During their walk, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her plans to substitute as a teacher in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and feels a bittersweet nostalgia for how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has changed.

## Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) arrives at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and gets a ride to her boarding house with Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who is filling in on the mail route for her new husband. During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) entertains [Anne](../character/anne.md) with stories about choosing true love over wealth and warns her about local geography before dropping her off at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).

## Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Esther](../character/esther.md), [Irving](../character/irving.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) writes a letter to [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) describing her new life as a schoolteacher at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), boarding with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). She describes her cozy accommodations, Janet's cooking, and an awkward visit from the neighbor's hired boy, [Sam](../character/sam.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) also hints at an ongoing elderly romance in the area, though she vows not to interfere after a past mishap.

## Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Janet](../character/janet.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) to a prayer meeting in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where they meet [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who walks [Janet](../character/janet.md) home. Later, John invites [Janet](../character/janet.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) to his house for tea to meet his mother, who acts excessively sweet and fragile while subtly making [Janet](../character/janet.md) uncomfortable. [Anne](../character/anne.md) notices John's pained expression during the visit and wonders about the true dynamic in his household as they return to [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside).

## Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to find [Janet](../character/janet.md) crying on her fortieth birthday because [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) has been visiting her for twenty years without proposing. Encouraged by [Anne](../character/anne.md) to stand up for herself, [Janet](../character/janet.md) coldly rejects John's offer to walk her home after a prayer meeting. However, seeing John's hurt reaction, [Anne](../character/anne.md) immediately regrets her advice and runs after him to bring him back to [Janet](../character/janet.md).

## Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

**[Alec](../character/alec.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Janet](../character/janet.md), [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). Shortly after, [Alec](../character/alec.md) arrives to announce that John Douglas's mother is dying, and she passes away soon after. Following the funeral, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) comes to [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) and proposes to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his late mother had forced him to swear a secret oath not to marry while she was alive.

## Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — The girls return to Patty's Place and chatter with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about their vacations, Phil's engagement, and Aunt Jamesina's past suitors. Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cure a rainy-day bout of melancholy by reading over old, melodramatic stories written by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club), inspiring [Anne](../character/anne.md) to rewrite one of her old sketches.

## Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives news that her short sketch has been accepted by a publication, sparking literary excitement among the girls at Patty's Place. While on a walking party, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne.md) that his mother and sisters plan to call on her. The Gardners arrive a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to an awkward but ultimately successful first visit despite cat chaos and a ruined chocolate cake.

## Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their examinations finish up. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne.md) chooses Gilbert's lilies over Roy's violets to carry, but later learns of a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), leading her to secretly break the chain [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave her. After attending the graduation dance, the girls unwind back at Patty's Place while [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) mentions a visitor.

## Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — At Patty's Place, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on their time together and pack up as their college life ends. [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) to the harbor pavilion and proposes, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) suddenly realizes she does not love him and refuses his offer. Deeply upset, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home and confesses the rejection to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who scolds her before ultimately offering comfort.

## Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Inglis](../character/inglis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Simon Fletcher](../character/simon-fletcher.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.

## Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [George Fletcher](../character/george-fletcher.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and learns from her family that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. Keeping a stormy night watch in her room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realizes she has always loved [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and despairs over her foolishness. In the morning, she meets [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote in the yard and learns that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.

## Chapter 43

**[Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), [Inglis](../character/inglis.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) to go for a walk, but she must prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next afternoon, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to her again. [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts, and they share their mutual feelings and clarify past misunderstandings before walking home engaged.
